title: Structured AI ideation proposes physical strategies for epithelial barrier repair
summary: The Abelio AI system proposed membrane-tethered PEG and cholesterol-anchored complementary DNA as physical interventions for epithelial barrier restoration, with both proposals archived before experiments. In damaged Caco-2 monolayers PEG preserved barrier function in a membrane-surface-dependent manner, and complementary DNA gave sequence-specific restoration that was reversible on demand. The work is a preprint in an in vitro cell model only.
